description: This file defines the code-behind class for the 'EditTheory' ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, course selection, and semester selection, including dynamic population of a course dropdown based on semester selection.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the EditTheory ASP.NET page, handling user interactions and dynamic content updates.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently empty.
